name: Indifference
overview: Scripture warns against spiritual indifference, portraying it as a dangerous state where people become complacent and assume God will neither bring good nor evil, as seen in Zephaniah's depiction of those 'settled on their lees.' Jesus challenges believers to prioritize God's kingdom above all else, contrasting this with a generation characterized by lukewarmness and cold love, which leads to spiritual decay and judgment, as highlighted in Matthew and Revelation. Instead, Romans calls for transformation through the renewing of the mind to discern and live out God's perfect will, urging believers to avoid conformity to the world and to reject the complacency that indifference fosters.
